```python
import re

def canonical_url(url):
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        raise ValueError("URL must be a string")

    # 1. Check scheme and lowercase
    url = url.lower()
    if not (url.startswith("http://") or url.startswith("https://")):
        raise ValueError("URL must start with http:// or https://")

    scheme_end = url.find("://")
    if scheme_end == -1:
        # Should be caught by the check above, but as a safeguard
        raise ValueError("Invalid URL scheme")

    host_and_path_part = url[scheme_end + 3:]

    # 2. Remove fragment
    path_and_query = host_and_path_part.split('#')[0]

    # 3. Remove single trailing slash from non-root paths
    if path_and_query.endswith('/') and len(path_and_query) > 1:
        # If it ends with a slash and is longer than just '/', remove it
        path_and_query = path_and_query[:-1]

    return path_and_query
```

class TestCanonicalUrl(unittest.TestCase):

    # Test basic functionality: lowercasing, fragment removal
    def test_basic_url_and_fragment(self):
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("HTTP://Example.Com/path#fragment"), "http://example.com/path")
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("https://test.com/resource"), "https://test.com/resource")
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("HTTP://EXAMPLE.com/resource#query=1"), "http://example.com/resource")

    # Test trailing slash removal
    def test_trailing_slash_removal(self):
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://www.example.com/path/"), "http://www.example.com/path")
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://www.example.com/"), "http://www.example.com")
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://example.com/a/b/c/"), "http://example.com/a/b/c")

    # Test preserving query parameters
    def test_query_parameters_preservation(self):
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://example.com/page?id=1&sort=asc"), "http://example.com/page?id=1&sort=asc")
